articles.abstract_en: Dr. Amy W. Ando is Professor and Department Chair in the Department of Agricultural, Environmental, and Development Economics at The Ohio State University. She earned a BA in economics from Williams College in 1990 and a PhD in economics from MIT in 1996. She was a professor at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign in the Department of Agricultural and Consumer Economics from 1999 to 2023 and before that she worked as a research Fellow in Resources for the Future, where she still has an affiliation as a University Fellow. She was inducted as a Fellow of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists in 2023 and a Fellow of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association in 2025. Dr. Ando has built a record of scholarly publications related to habitat and species conservation, ecosystem service provision and valuation, and ag-environmental policy. She has had nearly $6 million in grants from sources including the NSF, EPA, and USDA-NIFA and has been published in journals such as Science, the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, the American Journal of Agricultural Economics, and the Journal of Environmental Economics and Management. Ando has been a Co-Editor of the American Journal of Agricultural Economics, has served as a handling editor for other major journals in her field, and worked on numerous review panels for the National Science Foundation. She has served as an elected member of the Board of Directors for the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association and as an elected Board member and Vice President of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists. She has been a member of the Board on Agriculture and Natural Resources for the National Academies of Sciences and she has provided expert advisory service to agencies and NGOs including the US Department of Agriculture, the US Environmental Protection Agency, the Doris Duke Charitable Foundation, and The Nature Conservancy in Illinois.
articles.abstract_cn: 艾米·W·安多博士是俄亥俄州立大学农业、环境与发展经济学系的教授兼系主任。她于1990年获得威廉姆斯学院经济学学士学位，并于1996年获得麻省理工学院经济学博士学位。她于1999年至2023年在伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校农业与消费经济学系担任教授，此前她曾在未来资源研究所担任研究员，目前仍以大学研究员身份隶属于该机构。她于2023年入选环境与资源经济学家协会会士，并于2025年入选农业与应用经济学协会会士。安多博士在栖息地与物种保护、生态系统服务提供与价值评估以及农业环境政策等领域积累了丰富的学术出版物。她获得了来自国家科学基金会、环境保护署和美国农业部国家食品与农业研究所等来源的近6百万美元资助，并在《科学》、《美国国家科学院院刊》、《美国农业经济学杂志》和《环境经济学与管理杂志》等期刊上发表论文。安多曾担任《美国农业经济学杂志》的联合编辑，并担任其领域内其他主要期刊的处理编辑，同时为美国国家科学基金会多个评审小组工作。她曾当选农业与应用经济学协会董事会成员，并担任环境与资源经济学家协会的当选董事会成员和副主席。她曾是美国国家科学院农业与自然资源委员会成员，并为美国农业部、美国环境保护署、多丽丝·杜克慈善基金会和伊利诺伊州大自然保护协会等机构和组织提供专家咨询服务。

articles.title_en: De gustibus est disputandum : The role of agricultural and applied economists in an era of behavior change initiatives and endogenous preferences
articles.title_cn: 品味之争：行为改变倡议与内生偏好时代农业与应用经济学家的角色
articles.abstract_en: Popular society increasingly questions preferences that drive many resource allocations and production decisions, with many groups actively seeking to alter those preferences to achieve changes to resource use. Agricultural and applied economists, who are already equipped with excellent technical skills to undertake consumer preference and valuation studies, must also be challenged to understand post‐Beckerian consumer theories that can help guide emerging requests placed upon economists as multi‐disciplinary collaborators as non‐academic groups press us to join in work involving interventions that work from the implicit assumption that preferences are malleable and potentially endogenous. I call association members to follow our best traditions of studying production dynamics and incorporating emerging theories drawn from or inspired by other disciplines so that we may better interact with the broader scientific community who, as many suggest, finds our insistence on stable and static preferences to limit the usefulness of economists in handling a raft of modern dilemmas. In addition to setting out the history of economists' reticence in considering endogenous preferences, I will outline several threads of emerging literature that can provide structure to professional inquiry in this domain and sketch some emergent cases with implications for the agricultural and resource sectors.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会大众日益质疑驱动许多资源配置和生产决策的偏好，许多群体积极寻求改变这些偏好以实现资源使用的变化。农业与应用经济学家，虽然已具备优秀的技术技能来进行消费者偏好和估值研究，但也必须接受挑战，理解后贝克尔时代的消费者理论，这些理论有助于指导新兴的请求，即经济学家作为多学科合作者，当非学术团体敦促我们参与那些基于偏好可塑且可能内生这一隐含假设的干预工作时。我呼吁协会成员遵循我们研究生产动态的最佳传统，并纳入源自或受其他学科启发的新兴理论，以便我们更好地与更广泛的科学界互动，正如许多人所说，科学界发现我们坚持稳定和静态的偏好限制了经济学家在处理一系列现代困境中的实用性。除了阐述经济学家在考虑内生偏好方面的历史犹豫之外，我还将概述几支新兴文献，这些文献可以为该领域的专业探究提供结构，并勾勒一些对农业和资源部门具有影响的新兴案例。

articles.title_cn: 基于土地的碳减排经济学
articles.abstract_en: Agricultural land holds tremendous potential to contribute to net zero greenhouse gas emission goals by providing low carbon renewable energy to displace fossil fuels and by serving as a sink for sequestering carbon in the soil with climate‐smart practices. This potential is, however, far from being realized. This paper examines the economic incentives and barriers to implementing land‐based carbon mitigation strategies and discusses the specific features of land‐based carbon mitigation practices on carbon emissions that need to be considered in designing policy incentives to induce adoption. Although a carbon price‐based policy is socially efficient, the more commonly observed policies to promote land‐based carbon mitigation include practice‐based conservation programs, technology mandates, and sector‐specific standards. The paper discusses the rationale for these alternative policy approaches and concludes with a discussion of emerging opportunities for designing policy and market‐based approaches for promoting land‐based carbon‐mitigation and future directions for economics research.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业土地在通过提供低碳可再生能源替代化石燃料以及通过气候智能型实践作为土壤碳封存的汇，为实现净零温室气体排放目标方面拥有巨大潜力。然而，这一潜力远未得到实现。本文考察了实施基于土地的碳减排战略的经济激励与障碍，并讨论了在设计政策激励以诱导采纳时需要考虑的基于土地的碳减排实践对碳排放的具体特征。尽管基于碳价格的政策在社会效率上是优的，但更常见的促进基于土地的碳减排的政策包括基于实践的 conservation 项目、技术指令和部门特定标准。本文讨论了这些替代政策方法的合理性，并最后讨论了设计促进基于土地的碳减排的政策和市场方法的新兴机会以及经济学研究的未来方向。

articles.abstract_en: Retail food prices rose dramatically in late 2021. Some argue that this food price inflation was due to “greedflation,” or firms increasing downstream prices simply because they can. In this study, we investigate the sources of “overshifting” store‐level cost shocks into downstream prices, or the apparent ability of retailers to pass along price increases that are proportionately larger than increases in cost. We use exogenous changes in minimum wages as our setting and study how food retailers pass increases in labor costs along to consumers in the form of higher food prices. We derive a new theoretical model of retail price pass‐through and show that demand curvature, market power, and consumer search behavior each likely affect observed rates of retail price pass‐through. Our structural analysis shows that, after controlling for the primary determinants of wage pass‐through, market power and demand curvature explain much of the variation in cost pass‐through, although general price inflation has an important role in accentuating the rate of minimum wage pass‐through. Our findings have important implications for minimum wage policy, and for understanding the role of cost shocks in food price inflation.
articles.abstract_cn: 2021年末，零售食品价格急剧上涨。有人认为这种食品价格通胀是由于“贪婪通胀”，即企业仅仅因为能够提高下游价格而提高价格。在本研究中，我们调查了“过度传导”店铺层面成本冲击至下游价格的来源，即零售商似乎能够将价格涨幅按比例大于成本增幅进行传导的能力。我们以最低工资的外生变化为背景，研究食品零售商如何将劳动力成本增加以更高食品价格的形式传导给消费者。我们推导了一个新的零售价格传导理论模型，并表明需求曲率、市场力量和消费者搜索行为各自可能影响观察到的零售价格传导率。我们的结构分析显示，在控制了工资传导的主要决定因素后，市场力量和需求曲率解释了成本传导的大部分变化，尽管总体价格通胀在加剧最低工资传导率方面起着重要作用。我们的发现对最低工资政策以及理解成本冲击在食品价格通胀中的作用具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: H‐ 2A adverse effect wage rates and U.S. farm wages
articles.title_cn: H-2A不利影响工资率与美国农业工资
articles.abstract_en: Recently proposed legislation regarding farm labor would impact the minimum wage for workers with H‐2A visas. Adverse Effect Wage Rates (AEWRs) are regional minimum wages paid to foreign farmworkers working in the United States under the H‐2A temporary agricultural guest worker program. Recent increases in AEWRs have prompted discussions over the methodology and data sources used to compute them, including debates about whether AEWRs should be frozen or capped in the future. Employer and farmworker groups hold opposing views on the desirability and implications of changes to AEWRs. In this paper, we develop a simple theoretical framework that suggests higher AEWRs may induce spillover effects that lead to higher wages for non‐H‐2A farmworkers. Using confidential wage data from the National Agricultural Workers Survey, we test the labor market spillover hypothesis by comparing changes in non‐H‐2A farmworker wages and AEWRs across U.S. regions between 1996 and 2022. Our estimates suggest that a 10% increase in the AEWR causes, at most, a 2.8% increase in the wages of non‐H‐2A farmworkers across the United States. We find that freezing the AEWR for 1 year would reduce the growth of wages paid to non‐H‐2A farmworkers by as much as $475 million. Our analysis suggests that the recent policy proposals could lower labor costs for U.S. farm employers but limit wage growth for non‐H‐2A farmworkers.
articles.abstract_cn: 最近提出的关于农业劳动力的立法将影响持有H-2A签证工人的最低工资。不利影响工资率（AEWRs）是支付给在美国根据H-2A临时农业客工计划工作的外国农业工人的地区性最低工资。近期AEWRs的增加引发了关于计算这些工资率所用方法和数据来源的讨论，包括关于未来是否应冻结或限制AEWRs的辩论。雇主和农场工人团体对AEWRs变化的可取性和影响持有相反观点。在本文中，我们开发了一个简单的理论框架，表明较高的AEWRs可能引发溢出效应，导致非H-2A农业工人工资上升。利用国家农业工人调查的保密工资数据，我们通过比较1996年至2022年间美国各地区非H-2A农业工人工资和AEWRs的变化来检验劳动力市场溢出假说。我们的估计表明，AEWR每增加10%，最多导致美国非H-2A农业工人工资增加2.8%。我们发现，将AEWR冻结1年将使非H-2A农业工人工资增长减少高达475亿美元。我们的分析表明，最近的政策提案可能降低美国农业雇主的劳动力成本，但限制非H-2A农业工人的工资增长。

articles.title_en: Econometric evaluation of the impact of agricultural conservation on nonpoint source pollution: An application to the Wabash River watershed
articles.title_cn: 农业保护对非点源污染影响的经济计量评估：以沃巴什河流域为例
articles.abstract_en: Agricultural production is the largest contributor of nitrogen and phosphorus pollution in lakes, rivers, and streams in the United States. The effectiveness of agricultural conservation programs that encourage farmers to adopt certain practices to reduce this water pollution, once implemented, is an open question. We develop a unique data set combining the spatial structure of the watershed river system, the timing of federal conservation contracts, water quality measurements, land use, land cover, and weather data to study the effect of conservation contracts on nitrogen and phosphorus levels in the Wabash River watershed, which drains Indiana and Illinois. We develop econometric models that generate a causal understanding of the effectiveness of these conservation contracts for reducing nitrogen and phosphorus levels in the surface water system. We find that at current treatment levels, these programs reduce surface water pollution only during relatively dry periods. The efficacy of these programs in the study area is highly sensitive to precipitation to the extent that average precipitation can eliminate the nutrient loss reduction benefits of conservation program installations at current treatment levels. Therefore, we find weak evidence to support ambient downstream water quality improvements resulting from program investment levels to date. We anticipate this work will motivate further inquiry into the manner in which these conservation programs have or have not been effective.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业生产是美国湖泊、河流和溪流中氮和磷污染的最大贡献者。鼓励农民采取某些措施以减少这种水污染的农业保护计划，一旦实施，其有效性是一个悬而未决的问题。我们开发了一个独特的数据集，结合了流域河流系统的空间结构、联邦保护合同的时机、水质测量、土地利用、土地覆盖和天气数据，以研究保护合同对沃巴什河流域（该流域流经印第安纳州和伊利诺伊州）氮和磷水平的影响。我们开发了经济计量模型，以生成对这些保护合同在减少地表水系统中氮和磷水平方面的有效性的因果理解。我们发现，在目前的处理水平下，这些计划仅在相对干燥的时期减少地表水污染。这些计划在研究区域的有效性对降水高度敏感，以至于平均降水量可以消除当前处理水平下保护计划安装带来的养分流失减少效益。因此，我们发现支持迄今为止计划投资水平所带来的环境下游水质改善的证据较弱。我们预计这项工作将激发对保护计划有效或无效方式的进一步探究。

articles.title_en: Is yield response enough? Drought impacts on crop acreage throughout the production cycle
articles.title_cn: 产量响应是否足够？干旱在整个生产周期中对作物种植面积的影响
articles.abstract_en: Climate change is amplifying the threat of drought to food security. Despite a growing literature examining how drought affects crop yield, previous studies have mostly overlooked the impacts of drought on production through planting and harvesting decisions, which are crucial climate adaptation strategies for farmers. To address this gap, we study corn and soybean production in U.S. counties from 2001 to 2023, examining drought impacts on acreage decisions—planned acres, prevented planting, crop abandonment—and yield within a unified framework. Decomposition analysis shows that, together, acreage decisions account for up to 25% and 20% of drought impacts on corn and soybean production, respectively. Moreover, drought affects production throughout the crop year, not solely during the growing season. Specifications that omit preplanting‐ and planting‐season drought underestimate the adverse impacts of growing‐season drought on the harvested ratio, yield, and production of corn and soybeans. Our findings highlight the importance of considering adaptive behavioral responses when quantifying climate‐related damage in agriculture.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化正在加剧干旱对粮食安全的威胁。尽管已有越来越多的文献研究干旱如何影响作物产量，但以往的研究大多忽视了干旱通过种植和收获决策对生产的影响，而这些决策是农民重要的气候适应策略。为弥补这一空白，我们研究了2001年至2023年美国各县的玉米和大豆生产，在统一框架内考察干旱对种植面积决策——计划面积、防止种植、作物弃收——以及产量的影响。分解分析表明，种植面积决策合计分别占干旱对玉米和大豆生产影响的25%和20%。此外，干旱在整个作物年度内影响生产，而不仅仅是在生长季节。省略播种前和播种季节干旱的设定会低估生长季节干旱对玉米和大豆的收获比例、产量和生产的负面影响。我们的研究结果强调了在量化农业气候相关损害时考虑适应性行为响应的重要性。

articles.title_en: Broadband internet speed upgrades and the farmland market: A shift‐share instrumental variable approach
articles.title_cn: 宽带互联网速度升级与农田市场：一种转移份额工具变量方法
articles.abstract_en: Access to reliable and affordable high‐speed internet is critical for economic growth, and broadband internet access is of particular concern in rural America. As the United States continues to invest in this vital infrastructure, we provide the first empirical examination of the impact of broadband internet speed upgrades on farm‐level sale prices and county‐level cash rents in 12 Midwestern US states from 2016 to 2021. We employ a Bartik shift‐share instrument with broadband technology shares to address the potential endogeneity in the deployment and upgrades of broadband internet. Our results indicate that a one megabit per second (Mbps) increase in download speed raises farmland sale prices by 0.268% and county‐level cash rents by 0.070%. Additionally, a one‐percentage‐point increase in the download speed growth rate leads to a 0.041 percentage point increase in the growth rate of county‐level cash rents. By decomposing the Bartik shift‐share instrument, we demonstrate that the exogeneity of the initial market share of satellite technology contributes most to identification. Our research provides valuable insights for policymaking by quantifying the return on broadband investment and identifying areas and types of farms that benefit more from higher internet speed.
articles.abstract_cn: 获得可靠且负担得起的高速互联网对经济增长至关重要，而宽带互联网接入在美国农村地区尤为令人关注。随着美国继续投资于这一关键基础设施，我们首次实证检验了宽带互联网速度升级对12个美国中西部州2016至2021年间农场层面销售价格和县级现金租金的影响。我们采用带有宽带技术份额的Bartik转移份额工具来解决宽带部署和升级中潜在的内生性问题。我们的结果表明，下载速度每增加一兆比特每秒（Mbps），农田销售价格提高0.268%，县级现金租金提高0.070%。此外，下载速度增长率每增加一个百分点，县级现金租金增长率增加0.041个百分点。通过分解Bartik转移份额工具，我们证明卫星技术初始市场份额的外生性对识别贡献最大。我们的研究通过量化宽带投资的回报并识别从更高互联网速度中受益更多的地区和农场类型，为政策制定提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title_en: Nonclassical measurement error in farmland markets with implications for Ricardian analysis
articles.title_cn: 农田市场中的非经典测量误差及其对李嘉图分析的影响
articles.abstract_en: Nonclassical measurement error threatens the validity of empirical economic models. We examine the extent to which land value measures that are commonly used in studies of the US farmland market are subject to nonclassical measurement error. We consider differences in county‐level land values from two popular data sources: (1) self‐reported land value assessments from the 2017 US Census of Agriculture and (2) observed sales prices from agricultural land transactions (2013–2017). We find that the difference between these data sources, which we interpret as measurement error, is correlated with multiple determinants of land value. Farmland market characteristics, including market size, are negatively related to this difference, implying that more information in a market allows respondents to better update their priors about their land's value. Survey respondents are also slow to update their assessments in areas of rapid recent price changes. Surprisingly, we find measurement error in farmland value to be correlated with climate. To illustrate the empirical implications, we conduct a Ricardian analysis of agricultural climate change impacts and find that temperature, in particular, is differentially capitalized into self‐reported land value estimates and sales prices. Under certain climate specifications, using self‐reported land values generates climate damage estimates that are more pessimistic but ultimately not significantly different from those using sales prices. However, regional heterogeneity highlights where this difference is significant, namely the northern half of the eastern United States. More generally, our findings highlight important considerations for researchers relying on farmland values from alternative data sources.
articles.abstract_cn: 非经典测量误差威胁着实证经济模型的有效性。我们考察了美国农田市场研究中常用的土地价值指标在多大程度上受到非经典测量误差的影响。我们考虑了来自两个流行数据源的县级土地价值差异：（1）2017年美国农业普查的自我报告土地价值评估，以及（2）2013-2017年农业土地交易中的观测销售价格。我们发现，这两个数据源之间的差异（我们将其解释为测量误差）与土地价值的多个决定因素相关。农田市场特征，包括市场规模，与这一差异呈负相关，这意味着市场中的更多信息使得受访者能够更好地更新其关于土地价值的先验信念。调查受访者在近期价格快速变化的地区也更新评估较慢。令人惊讶的是，我们发现农田价值的测量误差与气候相关。为了说明实证含义，我们进行了农业气候变化影响的李嘉图分析，发现温度尤其被差异性地资本化到自我报告的土地价值估计和销售价格中。在某些气候规格下，使用自我报告的土地价值产生的气候损害估计更为悲观，但最终与使用销售价格的估计没有显著差异。然而，区域异质性突出了这种差异显著的地方，即美国东部的北半部。更普遍地，我们的发现强调了依赖替代数据源农田价值的研究人员需要考虑的重要因素。

articles.title_en: Resource windfalls and political sabotage: Evidence from 5.2 million political ads
articles.title_cn: 资源意外之财和政治破坏：来自 5.2 百万政治广告的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of incentives in inducing sabotage in political contents, vis‐à‐vis natural resource windfalls. The latter induce plausibly exogenous increases in contests' stakes by extending opportunities for policy implementation or private gain upon winning and enhancing incumbent advantage. A model of political contests with endogenous sabotage indicates that higher stakes increase sabotage in political campaigns. We validate these predictions using over 5 million TV ads from United States gubernatorial elections (2010–2020), leveraging plausibly exogenous variations in states' natural resource endowments. Results show that resource windfalls significantly escalate negative campaigning: A standard deviation increase in resource windfalls leads to a 10% rise in campaign negativity. We show that this effect is primarily fueled by corruption and observed most strongly in symmetric, more competitive environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了激励措施在政治内容中诱导破坏以及自然资源意外收获方面的作用。后者通过扩大政策实施的机会或在赢得和增强现有优势时获得私人收益，从而引起竞争赌注的外生增加。具有内源性破坏的政治竞争模型表明，更高的赌注会增加政治运动中的破坏。我们利用美国州长选举（2010-2020）中超过5百万个电视广告来验证这些预测，并利用各州自然资源禀赋的合理外生变化。结果表明，资源意外之财显着加剧了负面竞选：资源意外之财的标准差增加导致竞选负面情绪上升10%。我们表明，这种效应主要是由腐败造成的，并且在对称、竞争更激烈的环境中观察得最为强烈。

articles.title_en: Productivity growth from genetic improvement: Evidence from Illinois soybean trial data
articles.title_cn: 遗传改良带来的生产率增长：来自伊利诺伊州大豆试验数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: In 2023, the United States produced 28% of the world's soybeans, making understanding yield trends in the United States important for understanding global price trends. We estimate yield growth due to genetic change in soybeans using Illinois variety trial data with a modified approach. Specifically, our approach uses the yield from “check varieties” that are planted consistently from 1997 to 2020 as a control variable to identify the gain in yield across years using only yield variation within the plot and year. Ours are the first estimates of genetic gain in commercial soybean varieties after 2010 and we find that soybean yields increased between 25 and 26 kg/ha (0.37–0.38 bu/acre), or 0.7%, per year at a roughly linear rate in the past two decades. We find mixed evidence that the yield of genetically engineered soybeans grew faster than conventional varieties: In many years, conventional varieties did just as well as genetically engineered ones. We also find that adding the check variety's yield as a control variable significantly impacts how models in the literature estimate the average annual yield gain from genetics in these data. Our findings suggest that genetic change continued to be a consistent driver of yield change in soybeans over the past two decades.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2023年，美国生产了全球28%的大豆，这使得理解美国的产量趋势对于理解全球价格趋势至关重要。我们使用伊利诺伊州品种试验数据，采用一种改进的方法来估计大豆遗传变化带来的产量增长。具体来说，我们的方法使用从1997年到2020年持续种植的“对照品种”的产量作为控制变量，仅利用地块和年份内的产量变异来识别跨年份的产量增益。我们是首个在2010年之后估计商业大豆品种遗传增益的研究，我们发现大豆产量在过去二十年中以大致线性的速度每年增加25至26公斤/公顷（0.37-0.38蒲式耳/英亩），即0.7%。我们发现，关于转基因大豆产量增长是否快于传统品种的证据不一：在许多年份，传统品种的表现与转基因品种一样好。我们还发现，将对照品种的产量作为控制变量加入，显著影响了文献中模型对这些数据中遗传带来的年均产量增益的估计方式。我们的研究结果表明，在过去二十年中，遗传变化持续是大豆产量变化的一个稳定驱动因素。

articles.title_en: Substitutes or complements? The effect of opening a food store on customer visits to neighborhood food stores
articles.title_cn: 替代品还是互补品？食品店开业对邻近食品店顾客到访的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of new food store openings on customer traffic to incumbent stores using a modified difference‐in‐differences approach and cellphone location data from the contiguous United States in 2019. Analysis of both the intensive margin (total visit counts) and the extensive margin (unique visitors) reveals substantial spatial, temporal, and demographic heterogeneity, highlighting that ignoring these variations may lead to misleading conclusions about customer behavior. Grocery store openings, for example, reduce visits to food‐at‐home incumbents in close proximity but affect food‐away‐from‐home incumbents over broader distances. The magnitude of these effects varies with demographics. Entrant stores offering fresh food options, such as grocery stores, reduce traffic to outlets that sell more processed foods—such as fast‐food and convenience stores. However, the reductions remain modest—generally below 5% of monthly visits—and are statistically significant for White and high‐income visitors when disaggregated by demographics. Complementarity effects emerge when entrants and incumbents are not direct competitors, particularly within a one‐mile range. For instance, grocery entry does not reduce traffic to fast‐food stores nearby but does so at greater distances. Conversely, competition within similar store formats intensifies business‐stealing effects, such as dollar store openings reducing traffic to other smaller store formats while leaving grocery stores unaffected. These findings underscore the competitive dynamics shaping the U.S. food environment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究采用修正的双重差分方法和2019年美国本土的手机定位数据，考察了新食品店开业对现有店铺顾客流量的影响。对集约边际（总访问次数）和广延边际（独立访客数）的分析揭示了显著的空间、时间和人口统计异质性，强调忽视这些差异可能导致对顾客行为的误导性结论。例如，杂货店开业会减少近距离内居家食品店的访问量，但会在更广的距离上影响外出就餐的现有店铺。这些效应的幅度随人口统计特征而变化。提供新鲜食品选择的新进入者，如杂货店，会减少对销售更多加工食品的店铺（如快餐店和便利店）的流量。然而，这些减少幅度仍然较小——通常低于每月访问量的5%——并且按人口统计特征细分时，对白人和高收入访客在统计上显著。当进入者与现有店铺不是直接竞争对手时，会出现互补效应，尤其在一英里范围内。例如，杂货店进入不会减少附近快餐店的流量，但在更远距离上会减少。相反，类似店铺形式内的竞争会加剧业务抢夺效应，如一元店开业减少其他小型店铺形式的流量，而杂货店则不受影响。这些发现强调了塑造美国食品环境的竞争动态。

articles.title_en: Discrimination in science: Salaries of foreign and U.S. born land‐grant university scientists
articles.title_cn: 科学中的歧视：外国出生与美国出生的赠地大学科学家的薪资差异
articles.abstract_en: The dominance of the US innovation and academic system relies heavily on foreign‐born labor for its success. Recent literature has shown evidence of wage gaps in academia based on gender and race; however, little is known about whether a wage gap might exist for foreign‐born faculty. This paper studies the compensation gap between US‐ and foreign‐born agricultural and life science faculty at 52 US land‐grant universities (LGU) using a survey of over 1400 scientists conducted in 2005 and 2015. We develop a framework to categorize the sources of a potential compensation gap into testable categories that capture direct discrimination as well as indirect ( systemic ) discrimination. We find wage differences in total annual compensation among the foreign‐born and the US‐born, tenure‐track faculty, however, the gap in the base annual salary is insignificant. This suggests that additional salary components like grants and summer teachings may not be equally available to foreign‐born faculty even though, on average, foreign‐born scientists work are more productive than US‐born scientists on most common output metrics. The decomposition analysis suggests that about one‐half of the gap (at 10% level) in the base salary and 60% of the differences in total salary (at 5% level)is due to various types of direct or systemic discrimination. Using our framework, we then rule in and rule out some important types of systemic discrimination.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国创新和学术体系的主导地位在很大程度上依赖于外国出生的劳动力。近期文献已显示学术界基于性别和种族的薪资差距证据；然而，关于外国出生的教职人员是否存在薪资差距，知之甚少。本文利用2005年和2015年对超过1400名科学家的调查，研究了美国52所赠地大学（LGU）中农业和生命科学领域美国出生与外国出生教职人员的薪酬差距。我们开发了一个框架，将潜在薪酬差距的来源分类为可检验的类别，这些类别涵盖直接歧视以及间接（系统性）歧视。我们发现，在终身轨教职人员中，外国出生与美国出生的年度总薪酬存在差异，但基本年薪的差距不显著。这表明，尽管平均而言，外国出生的科学家在大多数常见产出指标上比美国出生的科学家更具生产力，但额外的薪酬组成部分，如科研经费和暑期教学，可能对外国出生的教职人员并不平等可得。分解分析表明，基本年薪差距的约一半（在10%水平上）和总薪酬差异的60%（在5%水平上）归因于各种类型的直接或系统性歧视。利用我们的框架，我们随后排除并确认了某些重要类型的系统性歧视。
